About me

A bit about who I am and the work I do in Toronto.

I'm Abid Tahiri, a Canadian citizen living in Toronto. Since February 2020 I've worked in customer service and operations at No Frills, where I help customers every day and keep daily store operations running — including loss-prevention support and CCTV basics.

Alongside that, I work hands-on with technology: troubleshooting computer hardware, running Ethernet and coaxial cabling, and setting up routers and switches. I hold an Ontario Security Guard licence (valid to September 2028) and First Aid with CPR-C and AED certification, and I'm building a career in IT support and security work across Toronto and Scarborough.

I graduated from David and Mary Thomson Collegiate Institute in Scarborough in April 2025, and I keep learning programming — Python, C++ and HTML — through my own projects.

At a glance

Looking for: IT support / field technician roles and licensed security guard work — full-time, downtown Toronto or Scarborough.

Projects

Things I've built and am building.

App

AT Afghan

A calling app that helps people in Canada reach family in Afghanistan. It has a Dari dialer for +93 numbers, saved contacts, and one-tap free app-to-app calls over WhatsApp, Telegram and IMO — plus an honest guide to what a direct call to an Afghan SIM costs.
